Scheme.Description: Uses finished BTCUSDT one-hour candles, fast and slow Parabolic SAR, and the highest and lowest prices of three candles to place one Fibonacci pullback limit at a time. It cancels an active limit when its setup reverses and closes a filled position at entry-snapshotted range stop or 161% target levels.
